title: Oklo
summary: US developer of small fast reactors for data-centre and industrial power.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Oklo is developing sodium-cooled fast reactors and a fuel-recycling business, targeting off-grid power for data centres and industrial customers. It has received site permits and design work but not yet a commercial operating licence. Regulatory progress and customer agreements drive the story.

Technology Exposure

  • Small fast reactors
  • Fuel recycling
  • Data-centre power agreements

What To Watch

  • NRC licensing progress
  • First customer deployments
  • Fuel supply

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
